description: Artifact search keeps an index of the stored files and checks it against storage.
title: Search

verifyEnabled.description: Run the nightly check that compares a sample of index rows with storage and repairs what differs.
verifyEnabled.title: Verify enabled

verifyAt.description: Time of day (UTC, HH:mm) at which the nightly verify run starts.
verifyAt.title: Verify at

verifySampleSize.description: Number of index rows one verify run compares with storage.
verifySampleSize.title: Verify sample size

rebuildSchedule.description: A full walk of storage on a fixed number of days. Off by default, because a full walk is expensive.
rebuildSchedule.title: Rebuild schedule

enabled.description: Start the rebuild on the schedule.
enabled.title: Enabled

at.description: Time of day (UTC, HH:mm) at which a scheduled rebuild starts.
at.title: At

gapRebuild.description: Start a rebuild after a start that finds a gap in the heartbeat, for example after a downgrade.
gapRebuild.title: Gap rebuild
